newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 400 mixed steers and heifers. For the week to date 3,700 head confirmed including 1,400 head previously contracted or formulated cattle. Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000 lb steers and heifers 67.00. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - 400
